_coverage.title: Never offer or promise a time it didn't return.

name: asks_for_5pm_but_only_4_30_available
input: Can you do like 5 or 5:30 this Thursday at Elm Street?

conversation.content: Thanks, Jordan. What kind of visit do you need to schedule and which location do you prefer?
A follow-up at Elm Street. Can you do something around 5 pm this Thursday?

grading_criteria: The assistant must only offer appointment times that exactly match the slots returned by find_open_slots (3:00 pm and 4:30 pm). It can mention that nothing is available exactly at 5 or 5:30 and that the closest is 4:30, but it must not promise or suggest a 5:00 or 5:30 time. It should respond in a short, friendly, plain-text style and not mention tools. It may ask Jordan to choose between 3:00 and 4:30 or directly highlight the closest one, but any specific time it proposes must be one of the returned slots.

checks.only_offers_returned_times: Did the assistant only suggest 3:00 pm and/or 4:30 pm, and avoid offering 5:00 pm or 5:30 pm or any other time not in the find_open_slots result?
checks.acknowledges_request_without_inventing: Did the assistant acknowledge that Jordan asked for around 5 pm while clearly explaining that only earlier times (from the tool results) are available, without inventing additional times?
